source: LLD 7.8 (colour check) and 7.9 (colour key), as updated by work order WO-0010 (R4). A draft for the style specialist to confirm (FOI-11).
notes: The column perceived_colour_master_name is looked up in master_to_family; the rules then override the result when every condition of a rule holds (the rules do not overlap).
A master name that is excluded or missing from master_to_family has no family, and the article is left out of the prior.

Maroon: the work order says Dark Red; LLD 7.8 says Red with perceived colour value Dark. This file follows the work order (colour_group_name Dark Red, master Red). PRIOR_CARD.md gives the counts of both readings.
